N. of a celebrated writer on civil polity; also known as बिष्णुगुप्त, कौटिल्य; see कौटिल्य.

A celebrated wrestler in the service of Kaṃsa. When Kṛṣṇa was taken by Akrūra to Mathurā, Kaṃsa sent this redoubtable wrestler to fight with him; but in the duel which ensued, Kṛṣṇa whirled him round and round several times and smashed his head. 
-Comp. 
-मर्दनः -सूदनः N. of Kṛṣṇa.
